target.statement: HyperFuse embedding time on Zoo (mean over 3 seeds) = 0.7 s, the fastest method on all datasets

compute.basis: Zoo is tiny (101 nodes, 1,717 incidences); Stage A/B are CPU linear algebra and Stage C is 100 full-batch epochs on 101 nodes, so the whole pipeline runs in seconds on CPU once the repo and TriCL-preprocessed Zoo data are installed; most time is environment setup and verifying the timing protocol.

blockers: Timing number is hardware-dependent (paper used NVIDIA T1000); exact 0.7 s will not match on a laptop
Zoo data must be obtained in TriCL's preprocessed form (not bundled in the paper's own links)
Repo completeness/configs unverified from the text
title: HyperFuse: Fast Self-Supervised Node Embeddings for Attributed Hypergraphs
